name: pharos-dao-governance
description: Full lifecycle DAO Governance Skill for Pharos Agent Center — create, vote, delegate, activity feed, health check, AI assessment

create_proposal.description: Create a proposal with threshold pre-check

get_proposals.description: List proposals (auto-detects GovernorBravo or OZ Governor via events)

proposal_details.description: View proposal details with vote tally and quorum

get_vote_power.description: Check voting power, delegation, active proposals

delegate_votes.description: Delegate voting power to an address

get_results.description: Live vote tally with quorum progress and block countdown

governance_activity.description: Time-bound governance activity feed: proposals, pass rate, most active proposer

delegate_insights.description: Delegate power analysis: top delegates, governance concentration (HHI), Nakamoto coefficient

governance_health.description: DAO health report — composite score (participation 25%, quorum 25%, success 20%, turnout 30%)

governance_risk_report.description: Governance Risk Report — composite risk score across 6 dimensions: centralization, participation, quorum, delegate diversity, success rate, proposal health

governance_assessment.description: AI Governance Assessment — data-driven signal (not advice). Risk + quorum + vote analysis → FOR/AGAINST/REVIEW

env.PRIVATE_KEY: Required for create, vote, and delegate operations
